contentHtml:
New Delhi: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA, has announced the launch of Calcium Gluconate Injection USP in the United States, expanding its portfolio of hospital injectables.

Glenmark’s Calcium Gluconate Injection USP is available in 1,000 mg/10 mL (100 mg/mL) Single-Dose Vials, 5,000 mg/50 mL (100 mg/mL) Single-Dose Vials and 10,000 mg/100 mL (100 mg/mL) Pharmacy Bulk Package.

The company said its Calcium Gluconate Injection USP is bioequivalent and therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug, Calcium Gluconate Injection, in the corresponding strengths, marketed by Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC under NDA 208418.

According to IQVIA sales data for the 12-month period ending June 2026, the US market for Calcium Gluconate Injection in the 1,000 mg/10 mL, 5,000 mg/50 mL and 10,000 mg/100 mL strengths recorded annual sales of approximately $69.9 million.

Commenting on the launch, Marc Kikuchi, President & Business Head, North America, said, “The launch of Calcium Gluconate Injection USP marks another important step in strengthening Glenmark’s U.S. injectables business and expanding our hospital portfolio.

It reflects the disciplined execution of our strategy to build a differentiated and sustainable injectables business – one that addresses institutional needs, supports greater supply resilience and deepens Glenmark’s relevance across the U.S. healthcare system,” he added.

Glenmark stated that its Calcium Gluconate Injection USP is approved only for the indications specified in the company's approved labeling.

The company noted that the market sales figure includes the brand and all available therapeutic equivalents. The IQVIA data obtained by Glenmark covers all approved reference listed drug indications, while Glenmark's product will only be marketed for the indications specified in its approved label, which may differ from those of the reference listed drug.

The sales data is based on IQVIA National Sales Perspectives: Retail & Non-Retail for June 2026.
